Elle intervient également pour tout ce qui concerne la protection de l’environnement, l’agriculture, l’aménagement du territoire. Vos missions Au sein de la Direction de l’Aménagement, du Développement et des Territoires (DADT), l’assistant(e) de direction accompagne la Directrice et l’équipe de direction dans l’organisation administrative et le bon fonctionnement de la direction. Il/elle assure également l’interface avec les autres directions du Département, les secrétariats des élus et les différents partenaires institutionnels. Activités principales Gérer les agendas, courriers et dossiers de la Directrice ; Organiser les réunions et instances de la direction (CODIR, COPIL, etc.) ; Relire, corriger et mettre en forme les documents administratifs ; Assurer le suivi des parapheurs, des rapports présentés en Commission Permanente et en Séance départementale ; Suivre et transmettre les demandes des élus, du Cabinet, de la DGS et de la DGAA ; Participer aux comités de direction et rédiger les comptes rendus ; Assurer l’accueil téléphonique et physique ; Diffuser les informations au sein de la direction ; Être référent(e) Maarch et communication de la direction. Activités complémentaires Assurer le rôle de référent(e) RH (accueil des nouveaux arrivants, suivi des fiches de poste, campagne EAE) ; Gérer les tableaux de congés et centraliser les besoins en fournitures et matériels ; Assurer le suivi des logiciels métiers (Maarch, Actes77, Eudonet) ; Participer à l’organisation logistique de la direction et assurer ponctuellement l’intérim d’autres assistant(e)s. Votre profil Vous êtes titulaire d’une formation en assistanat ou en gestion administrative et disposez idéalement d’une expérience sur un poste similaire. Organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et réactif(ve), vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques et les logiciels métiers. Doté(e) de solides qualités rédactionnelles et relationnelles, vous savez gérer les priorités avec discrétion et autonomie. Votre connaissance du fonctionnement des collectivités territoriales, votre sens du service public et votre goût du travail en équipe seront des atouts pour réussir dans ce poste. Les + qui font la différence Titres restaurant 25 CA et 24 RTT (sur la base de 39h hebdomadaires) Participation de l’employeur à votre cotisation de mutuelle santé Régime de prévoyance obligatoire Prestations sociales et Comité d’œuvres sociales (COS77) Nos atouts pour réussir ensemble Offres de formations Le poste est ouvert aux fonctionnaires par voie de détachement ou mutation et aux contractuels Le Département est ouvert à la diversité et facilite l’accueil et l’intégration des travailleurs handicapés.

review_candidates.description: Your Job As an Assistant Construction Manager with DEPCOM Power, you will support field execution across utility-scale solar and energy storage projects by partnering with Construction Managers and project teams to drive safe, high-quality project delivery. You will help coordinate Civil, Mechanical, and Electrical construction activities, support development of field leadership teams, and contribute to consistent processes that keep projects aligned with safety, quality, schedule, and budget objectives. Through collaboration with subcontractors, customers, and internal stakeholders, you will help ensure successful project execution while building the capabilities needed for future leadership opportunities. Current Project Site Opportunities Potential Locations: El Paso, TX Location subject to change based on business needs. Travel Requirements: This is a full-time, site-based position that includes daily per diem and home rotations approximately every 3-4 weeks. Compensation : $110,000 - $140,000 (flexible based on experience) Our Team DEPCOM's Project Delivery Organization executes full turnkey PV and BESS plants with collection substations and generation transmission lines. We utilize preferred partnerships with key vendors and subcontractors while coordinating with interconnection utilities across the nation. As a Koch Company, we implement Principle Based Management to continue driving innovation, hold our team to the highest standard and streamline our overall processes to ensure project success for each of our clients. What You Will Do Partner with the Construction Manager to support field execution across civil, mechanical, and electrical scopes for complex utility-scale solar and energy storage projects. Assist in developing and coaching Superintendent teams by reinforcing expectations, sharing knowledge, and promoting accountability for project results. Support coordination with Safety, Quality, Environmental, Logistics, and Project Management teams to ensure alignment on project priorities and execution plans. Help monitor project performance related to safety, schedule, quality, cost, and environmental compliance through proactive planning and field engagement. Participate in weekly risk assessments and contribute to maintaining the Risk & Opportunity (R&O) log to help identify and mitigate project risks. Support environmental compliance activities, including SWPPP requirements, permitting, erosion control measures, and regulatory obligations. Assist in managing subcontractor performance by monitoring productivity, schedule adherence, safety expectations, and contract compliance. Review subcontractor change order requests, invoices, and supporting documentation while partnering with project leadership to validate scope, progress, and costs. Support development and execution of comprehensive three-week look-ahead schedules and help identify constructability, logistics, and coordination challenges before they impact project performance. Build strong relationships with customers, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders through proactive communication and reliable execution. Who You Are (Basic Qualifications) Construction experience on large-scale industrial, infrastructure, renewable energy, or utility construction projects with exposure to field execution activities. Experience coordinating work with superintendents, subcontractors, or multiple construction disciplines while supporting safety, schedule, quality, and cost objectives. Experience reviewing project schedules, budgets, contracts, change orders, or construction documentation. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, and Word. Valid driver's license and ability to travel to project sites as required. What Will Put You Ahead Utility-scale solar, Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), substation or transmission experience. Experience supporting EPC or self-perform construction projects from mobilization through commissioning. Experience developing three-week look-ahead schedules, tracking project metrics, and supporting field productivity initiatives. Knowledge of environmental compliance requirements, including SWPPP implementation and permit management. At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy. Hiring Philosophy All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here. Who We Are As a Koch Engineered Solutions company, DEPCOM Power is a leading energy solutions partner for the utility solar and broader energy industries, providing project development support, engineering, procurement and construction, energy storage, repowering and operations and maintenance services. Our highly skilled team of conventional and renewable power industry experts work to deliver the lowest cost of energy and the highest rate of return. At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company. Our Benefits Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter. Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.
